case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your kind offer and for the reliable cooperation between our two family companies over the years. We would like to bundle the complete fastener kit with you, and we want to find a fair solution for both sides.

Before we do, our data shows a different picture on price:

German producer prices for fasteners changed +1.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08).

We also buy Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8, zinc from another source, at EUR 37.81 per 100 units on 2024-10-08 (po:4500011529-10) and EUR 37.64 per 100 units on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014454-10).

With this in mind, we have prepared three options, each with a longer contract term that gives your planning more security:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.26; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.23; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Please choose the option that suits Leitner & Sohn best. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
Here is the background.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
The price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
We greatly appreciate our long-standing cooperation and your intention to bundle the fastener kit with us.
While we note your reference to the producer price index, the competitor pricing provided relates to a different part and cannot be directly compared to this kit.
We are pleased to accept the 24-month contract term to provide you with planning security, and in return, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.53 per unit at 30 days net.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your warm reply and for moving on price and accepting the longer contract term. We value the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies.

On the price history, our own orders with you show a stable picture for comparable parts:

Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

On this basis, we have prepared options that keep the planning security of a longer term you welcomed:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.29; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.14; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.25; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Each option is a genuine way to close. We would be glad to bundle the full kit with you on whichever works best for your side.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate the data on your previous orders; however, the stable pricing on those specific items does not offset the cost increases affecting this particular kit. Main cost drivers include PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

To demonstrate our commitment to our long-standing partnership, we are willing to make a further concession. Our current offer stands at a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, we can offer EUR 5.51 per unit at 30 days net for a 24-month contract, which we believe is a fair compromise. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We are always eager to support your operations with our extensive range and dependable service, and we look forward to continuing our great working relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your further step and for the kind words about our partnership. We truly value the reliable cooperation between our two family companies and remain keen to bundle the complete fastener kit with you.

We have taken note of the cost drivers you mention. Our own records for a comparable part in the kit show a steady picture:

Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We also buy Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc from another source, at EUR 12.64 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011521-10) and EUR 12.64 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014468-20).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.32; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.16; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.28; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

All three options keep the longer contract term for mutual planning security. If you prefer shorter payment terms, the third option provides exactly that. We look forward to a fair solution for both sides.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your continued interest in bundling the kit with us and your preference for the 24-month contract. 

Regarding your feedback, the price history data you cite does not concern this part or our company. Furthermore, the price history you provided again relates to a different part and does not reflect the cost structure of this specific kit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary Angebot is a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. To move forward, we can offer a further concession to EUR 5.49 per unit for the 30-day payment term and 24-month contract.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your final offer and for the further step you have taken. We appreciate the open way you have explained your cost situation, and we are glad to accept your alternative proposal exactly as offered:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 5.49; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

This brings the complete fastener kit together with you under one agreement, a fair solution for both our family companies. We value the many years of reliable cooperation and look forward to continuing it.

Please send us the confirmation so we can complete the paperwork on our side.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
